name: Granite longere farmhouse
description: Long low Norman stone farmhouse (longere), 18.4 x 7.8 m: rubble granite walls with dressed quoins and window surrounds, a slate roof with three stone eaves dormers and massive stone stacks on both gables, an open oak woodshed lean-to with stacked logs on the east gable, a stone bench and a water butt by the door. Salle, kitchen with its hearth and a dairy; an open attic under the roof; two stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
